messages:
maya: quick sprint check-in for runtime perf work. short asks: who owns kernel batching PR, who owns KV cache heuristics, and what's our canary rollout window? linking details below. TL;DR: 3 items, need owners + review pings. https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1234

liam: kernel batching is on me (PR #1234). fixes microbatch alignment + hotpath lock contention. needs perf review before merge. ping @sophia for canary plan. minimal repro cmd:
```bash
./bench --model=gpt-small --seq=1024 --microbatch=8
```

devon: KV cache heuristics are mine. saw a small p99 bump on canary this morning (~+12%). metrics snippet:
`p50: 12ms, p95: 48ms, p99: 220ms -> 246ms (+12%)`
working on eviction TTL tuning and better prefix eviction ordering. will open PR later today.

sophia: canaries — propose 4h ramp after merge, monitor p99 + error-rate + trace spans. we need a tracing hook to tag these requests so we can filter. @arjun can you confirm trace header pass-through? prefer staged rollout to dedicated clusters if possible.

arjun: I can add the tracing hook, but it depends on a small platform change (pass trace headers through the proxy). I'll file platform#456 and cc eng-platform. ETA EOD tomorrow for the change.

talia: code review queue — @liam please drop perf benchmarks + CI artifacts in the PR. I can review kernel changes once CI is green. who owns the rollout doc backfill?

liam: perf bench results uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood/dev/bench/1234. CI logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/9876. added unit tests around kv lock paths.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary environment deployment queued (canary-3) — pipeline ID 2026-03-18-9; estimated duration 35m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

devon: note — KV warmup script needs a tiny change to pre-populate common prefixes (saves ~15% cold p95). I'll push patch to the same branch.

sophia: plan summary: merge kernel PR after review + tracing hook + KV patch. Ramp canary 4h, monitor p99/errs/traces. Owners: kernel = liam, KV = devon, canary ops = maya. @talia to review and approve. target merge: EOD tomorrow if no blockers. :thumbsup:

liam: ACK — I'll shepherd reviews, address nits, and post a final checklist here.

talia: reviewing now, left 2 small nits in the PR. will approve after quick fixes. :eyes:

maya: thanks all — added this to sprint board and tagged owners. ping me if any infra quota or capacity blocks.
